system.name: VideoMarathon
system.one_liner: Large-scale hour-long video instruction-following dataset with 3.3M QA pairs over 22 tasks in six topics, used to train Hour-LLaVA.

content.variant_note: a task taxonomy tree on top and a row of four statistics charts below, five lettered panels in all, one claim per panel in the caption
content.argues: VideoMarathon is diverse: 22 tasks in six topics covering short- and long-form comprehension, five video sources, varied question types, durations from 3 to 60 minutes, and multi-event videos.
content.subject: A task taxonomy tree of 22 leaves under six topics, two donut charts (sources, question types) and two histograms (duration, event counts).

lessons.what_to_learn: Summarise a dataset in one figure: a taxonomy tree with tall rotated-text leaves and one coloured tag per leaf for a binary attribute, above a row of small statistics charts (donuts for composition, histograms for durations and counts), each lettered and titled.
lessons.suits: Dataset or benchmark papers that want to show task coverage and basic statistics at once.

evidence: The task taxonomy consists of 22 QA tasks summarized from prior benchmarks and organized into six fundamental topics
Figure 1b presents the proportions of these video sources.
Figure 1e shows the distribution of event counts per video.

summary: VideoMarathon is a dataset of hour-long videos with 3.3M instruction-following QA pairs, built to train the Hour-LLaVA video model. Figure 1 is a dataset dashboard of five lettered panels. Panel (a) is a taxonomy tree with the VideoMarathon logo as root, six topic boxes (Temporality, Spatiality, Object, Action, Scene, Event) and 22 task leaves with rotated text, each topped by a yellow tag for short-form or a red tag for long-form comprehension. Below, (b) a donut chart of the five video sources, (c) a donut chart of question types, (d) a histogram of video durations up to 60 minutes and (e) a histogram of event counts per video.
summary_zh: VideoMarathon 是小时级长视频指令数据集。图 1 为数据集仪表盘：(a) 任务分类树，六个主题共 22 个竖排叶子，黄标短时、红标长时；(b)(c) 视频来源与问题类型环形图；(d)(e) 时长与事件数直方图。
notes: contribution-mosaic is kept as a secondary kind because the caption states one claim per panel. The y labels read #Videos in (d) and #Video in (e). The five panels were made as separate source files and then assembled.
